items.titulo: NVIDIA Introduces SoL-Pi: Auto-Research Loops That Cut Coding Agent Token Traffic by Up to 49%
items.resumen: NVIDIA researchers have released SoL-Pi, 4 harness mechanisms for the open-source Pi coding agent, discovered by an AI running auto-research loops across 535 environments. On EdgeBench, SoL-Pi cuts token traffic by 44.7% to 49.0% and API cost by roughly 33%, while keeping about 94% of Pi's score on GPT-5.6 Sol and Opus 5. items.titulo: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Image-2.1: A 7B Open-Weight Model for Image Generation and Editing
items.resumen: Alibaba's Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1, a 7B diffusion transformer that handles text-to-image generation, multi-reference editing, and native RGBA transparency in one checkpoint. A prefix KV cache speeds up edits with up to 10 reference images. The weights are public, but commercial use requires a separate license from Qwen.
